spine: Senior -> staff. Reilly's The Staff Engineer's Path is the backbone (big picture, execution, leveling up); system and ML design depth from DDIA and Designing ML Systems; writing from Software Engineering at Google; evidence and leveling last. Every lesson ends with a small 'at work this week' action.
rules: Every lesson: a short reading, the idea, one 'at work this week' action (15 minutes or less), and one graded free response (a doc section, a critique, or a decision write-up).
Your own work is the practice material: design docs, project plans and strategy docs are written for real projects (sanitized if needed), not invented ones.
Keep a brag document from lesson 1; each course adds entries. It becomes the promo packet or the interview story bank (SE160).

courses.title: Placement: where you are against a staff rubric
courses.note: Self-assessment against a public staff-level rubric (Larson's archetypes; a public career framework such as Dropbox's), a timed system-design exercise, a design-doc critique, and an inventory of evidence you already have (you lead cross-team projects, mentor and set direction). Sets which courses shrink.
